agent_kv.description: Stores the live agent_models + providers config. Optional; env var AGENT_CONFIG_JSON is the fallback when KV is empty.

PROXY_API_KEY.description: Bearer token clients must send on /v1/* endpoints.

AGENT_CONFIG_JSON.description: JSON string with shape { providers, agent_models }. Read on cold start; KV key 'config' takes precedence.

UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Read timeout when calling upstream LLM providers. Default 60000.

EDGEONE_FALLBACK_URL.description: Optional. When body > 1MB, returned in X-Fallback-Endpoint header. Point at the Cloud Function or VM endpoint.
